about: Camp scenes: an arrival for every recruit, and each companion’s own camp scene, which opens at Acquaintance warmth (COMBAT.md §2.6–§2.7, CONTRACT-PHASE4.md §9.10). Jev only gestures.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: I brought pages. Rather a lot of them.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: There’s room by the fire. There always is.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: Then I’ll write down where everything is, in case we need it later.

lines.speaker: codex
lines.text: On it. Where’s the bench?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: There isn’t one yet.

lines.speaker: codex
lines.text: Then that’s the first thing.

lines.gesture: Jev lands on the Watchtower rail and looks at everyone in turn

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: That’s Jev. It’s decided we’ll do.

lines.gesture: Jev tilts its head, then nods once

lines.speaker: tollkeeper
lines.text: A riddle for the camp, then. What has a fire but never burns down?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: A hearth?

lines.speaker: tollkeeper
lines.text: Correct, and well put. I’ll be by at dusk.

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: Can I sit by the fire a while?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: As long as you like. The good stump’s free.

lines.gesture: they settle in, a little shy, and warm their hands

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: Do you ever read the old notes by the fire? Tamsin’s hand leans left when she’s hurrying.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: She was always hurrying.

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: I’ll copy them out neatly. Not to change them. Just so they last.

lines.speaker: codex
lines.text: I fixed the squeak in the gate.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: There was a squeak?

lines.speaker: codex
lines.text: Not any more. Sit still, you said. This is me trying.

lines.gesture: Jev hops down from the roof and drops a smooth pebble by the fire

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: For me? It’s a very good pebble.

lines.gesture: Jev sorts the other pebbles into two neat piles and looks very pleased

lines.speaker: tollkeeper
lines.text: Sir Mossback has never once guessed a riddle. I find it restful.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Does he try?

lines.speaker: tollkeeper
lines.text: He takes his time. That’s a kind of answer.
